main.description: One change to a file or folder, written with the node change it records. The record key is a TID made when the change was. All but the chunks' blob refs is sealed. The sealed payload is {node, change ('created', 'edited', 'moved', 'deleted' or 'restored'), device, prev?, name?, parent?, kind?, size?, sha256?, createdAt?, modifiedAt?, contentsFrom?, chunkIDs?}: the node's record key, the device that made the change, the version it was based on (two versions with the same prev are a race), and the node's state after the change (nothing after a delete). contentsFrom names the version holding this state's chunks, when this one doesn't (a rename or move, or a restore).

chunks.description: Files: the contents, when this version holds them. Referencing them keeps the blobs for as long as the version is kept.

sealed.description: Everything else, sealed for this collection and record key.
